current_stage.name: Shared DS2 country/editorial convergence after resort-chip geometry repair
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #800 rebuilt the stale/conflicted #797 fix directly on current main and repaired a confirmed country-detail DS2 geometry inconsistency in the shared site-coherence owner. Informational resort chips in the country-intent hero inherited 38px desktop and 36px narrow-screen heights from the base editorial layer; the shared country hero now holds them at the canonical 44px visual rhythm across required widths without changing their non-interactive semantics. The patch changes only v2/site-coherence-v1.css. All 9 PR gates passed, including five-width standalone-content visual coverage plus V2 visual, selected-tour, bundle, standalone and security validation. PR #800 was squash-merged as 3993ca4b4ecbe617eaeda40a9bbf4e3ba0baa70a and stale #797 was closed superseded. Deploy V2 only completed successfully. The first main deploy completed copy/public-page/unchanged-lead-bridge/live-search product steps before being cancelled by newer-main concurrency; the newer descendant main deploy is the authoritative production run. Tourvisor, analytics/Metrika, lead transport, logo, verified destinations, pricing and unresolved legal/payment content were unchanged.
current_stage.next_action: Continue the shared country/editorial shell re-audit at 375/430/768/1024/1440, focusing on confirmed real CTA hierarchy/wrapping inconsistencies and the country/editorial → /poisk-turov/ handoff across /, /hot/, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/, /rb/, /country/ and representative country pages. Resort chips are informational labels, not actions: do not turn them into links/controls or invent new interaction behavior without an approved design/data contract. Preserve the mature search/results/selected-tour path and loaded-results instant-local-filtering architecture.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.
